items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: one of the girls, called the strawberry girl, Helen Dowdy, was coming upstairs which she was dressing up on the floor over me, and saw my door open, and she hollers, 'Sportin' Life, you're on.'

ctx.x: However, we do the song, I get the downbeat, I think it was on "Ain't Necessarily So," that this downbeat was given and I didn't take it on time. And from then on we did that, the rehearsal come down great. And after rehearsal, the night of rehearsal, the next day was the opening. And on the opening night everybody was thinking that John Bubbles ain't going to make it. They thought I would miss all my parts and everything, you know? Well, I had all -- I could do the whole show. They didn't know that. So -- I…
